title: AssessFraudRiskInput
description: The `data` part of the A2A TaskRequest.input for the assess_fraud_risk capability. Sent by a requesting peer (e.g. the customer-resolution-agent) and validated by the risk-fraud-agent (FR-002). The agent validates the required fields and ignores unknown fields so the wire shape can evolve. Note: unlike the billing input there is NO purchase_reference; risk attaches to the customer/account, so customer_id is the primary signal-lookup key.

case_id.description: Originating case correlation id. The agent publishes its risk result event with correlation_id == case_id so the requester's correlation-keyed consumer (risk_result_handler) matches it (research R2).

ticket_id.description: Support ticket id; echoed into RiskReviewCompletedPayload.ticket_id.

customer_id.description: Primary signal-lookup key: the customer/account the risk signals attach to.

requested_refund_amount.description: Disputed amount; context for refund-abuse / velocity reasoning. Never the basis for a billing-eligibility judgment (FR-009).

customer_message_summary.description: Optional context. Never overrides owned risk/fraud signals (FR-009).
